topography.project_purpose: Canonical Bridge. Structurally: 30 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 2 ERC20 tokens; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin-upgradeable.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 9 common project-authored base contract(s) (oappupgradeable, oappsenderupgradeable, oappcoreupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin-upgradeable.
